native_conclusion: Reached scalar/wide append bodies are MCF45/109 and R47/111 static instructions (wide public tail branch additional), frames80/64B. Positive full path directly executes malloc/memcpy/free versus realloc; no grow_full helper, repeated full/partial test, post-grow length reload or offered-record spill. Surviving grow_full symbols are not reached from these append bodies. Constructor follows allocation. Rust retains helper/allocator-shim calls, C++ calls emplace helper/new/memcpy/delete. Small-R loss is consistent with allocation-route tradeoff; static counts cannot assign nanoseconds. Remaining high-bit/no-growth guards do not establish a useful next variant.
replay: Checkout replay_base. Build candidate compiler using make -C compiler build and freeze it. Apply full-positive-reallocation-control.patch; build/freeze MCF compiler; restore source. Run recorded explicit make build/check arguments for each frozen CLI, then four recorded timed commands in recorded order with WHITEFOOT_CHECK_TIMEOUT=360. Original Makefile at replay_base preserves original link order. Builds and execution must be separately guarded; no concurrent heavy job.
